To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) routine use of BIS has a positive impact on the firm’s performance; 2) innovative use of BIS does not have a positive impact on firm performance; 3) the impact on firm performance is mediated by the impacts on marketing and sales and management and internal operations; and 4) the impacts on procurement and firm performance are not mediated.
routine and innovative uses of BISs are both important for creating an impact on firm’s marketing and sales, and management and internal operations.

(1) routine use and innovative BIS usage have positive effects on firm performance, (2) routine use has positive impact on marketing and sales and management and internal operations and (3) innovative use has positive impact only on procurement.
